'''Curse of Binding''' is a curse that prevents a worn item from being removed. It works as in vanilla, but in [[Matcha Flavoured]] it is stored on every crafted [[Hell-Bound Book]], and curses are the only enchantments an enchanting table can offer.

== Obtaining ==
* Every crafted [[Hell-Bound Book]] stores Curse of Binding I.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/hell_bound_book.json}}</ref> [[Blessing]]s crafted from it do not keep the curse.
* Ominous trial chamber vaults roll books from <code>#minecraft:in_enchanting_table</code>, which the pack reduces to the curses, so they only give Curse of Binding or Curse of Vanishing.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/enchantment/in_enchanting_table.json}}</ref>
* Random enchanted books in chests and fishing treasure.

== Behavior ==
Curse of Binding works as in vanilla. Applying a blank Hell-Bound Book to armor in an [[anvil]] gives the armor Curse of Binding. As a curse, it is not removed by a [[grindstone]].

Its anvil cost multiplier is 1, down from 8.
